ios.desc:
Not a quiz app. A social intelligence trainer.

Have you ever — 

walked away from a conversation thinking "that's not what I wanted to say"?
said "yes" when every part of you was screaming "no"?
felt your voice shake before you spoke up in a meeting?
replayed an awkward exchange in your head for hours afterward?

TalkFitly isn't another chat AI, quiz, or personality test.
Think of it as a training playbook written for adults — built on a curated library of real conversations, helping you turn "saying the right thing" into instinct.

▶ Real Scenarios, Real You
Setting boundaries with relatives. Pushing back when a colleague throws you under the bus. Negotiating salary without apologizing. Speaking up so your boss actually hears you. Public speaking without losing your voice. Every scenario comes from situations adults actually face — no textbook fluff.

▶ AI Scoring Beyond Right or Wrong
The AI coach evaluates four dimensions: clarity, emotional stability, assertiveness, empathy — and returns a composite score plus actionable feedback. Getting it wrong is okay; the point is knowing why, and how to do better next time.

▶ Quote Wall: Your Wins, Beautifully Kept
Every response that earns a high score gets saved automatically to your Quote Wall. A week later, scroll through and you'll see your own arc — from stiff to fluent, plain to confident. Not someone else's wisdom, but your own growth.

▶ Daily Micro-Sessions
Three minutes on the subway. Five minutes after lunch. Eight minutes before bed — TalkFitly serves you 1-3 scenarios tailored to your interests. More worth your time than scrolling reels.

▶ Private, Quiet, Non-Intrusive
We don't read private messages. We don't bombard you with push notifications. No social graph required. Your practice history belongs to you alone.

— Built For —
· Adults who hate conflict but get cornered by it anyway
· Professionals who deserve a raise but freeze at the ask
· Anyone whose "I should have said..." playlist runs at 3am
· People who want "high EQ" to be a learned skill, not a personality trait

— PRO Unlocks —
TalkFitly offers a 7-day free trial. With PRO:
· All scenarios (free tier: 3)
· Advanced AI scoring with detailed feedback
· Full Quote Wall access
· 5 daily scenarios (free tier: 1)

Subscription pricing (auto-renewing):
· Monthly: $2.99 / month
· Quarterly: $4.99 / 3 months (save 33% vs monthly)
· Yearly: $19.99 / year (save 44% vs monthly, includes 7-day free trial)

Subscriptions auto-renew. Cancel anytime
